observed_value: flag artifact has SOFR detected from identifier with blank metric/no structured corroboration
anchor_value: raw SOI rows contain separate Ref and Spread cells for the affected instruments

findings.detail: The raw SOI provides structured Ref and Spread cells for affected SOFR instruments, but the flagged artifact treats the SOFR reference as uncorroborated/metric blank.

rationale: Class 2 row-level review. The flagged rows are SOFR instruments whose concatenated identifiers include reference-rate and spread terms, while the flag artifact has blank metric/no structured corroboration. Raw source rows show these terms are not merely free text: the SOI schedule has explicit columns Issuer, Instrument, Ref(B), Floor, Spread, Total Coupon, Maturity, Principal, Cost, and Fair Value; cited rows place SOFR(M) or SOFR(Q) in the Ref column and the cash/PIK spread in the Spread column. Therefore the source corroborates structured reference/spread fields that the extraction/check failed to carry through.
